description:
If Christian believers go to Heaven, what is the purpose of the New Earth? Who will live on the New Earth and who will live in the New Jerusalem? Find out the answer to this question and many more on 3ABN Today Bible Q & A with Shelley Quinn, John Dinzey, and James Rafferty.


Send us your Bible Questions! 
By email: BibleQA@3abn.org 
By text: (618) 228-3975

QUESTIONS COVERED:

1. The Lord's Day and the Sabbath seem to be two completely different days. Is this the same 'day of the Lord' that some are erroneously correlating to Sunday, the day of the Lord? Is the Lord's Day and the Sabbath the same day?
 
2.  When Jesus rose from the tomb, they did not recognize him. Maybe because he had a glorified body but with some scars and a new robe. Is that how it will be when people rise from the dead at the 2nd coming and get a new robe?  Will we recognize our deceased loved ones when they are resurrected?
 
3. Was the story of the woman with the alabaster ointment the same person in all 4 gospels or 2 different people?  Who was the woman with the alabaster oil?
 
4.  The Bible states, “That no one knows the date or the hour of Christ’s second coming, no man, no angel, not even the Son, but the Father only”. How is that possible? If the Son is also God, He should know when He is coming! Can you please explain? How does Jesus not know the time of His return?
 
5. Can you explain 1 Corinthians 10:23-33? 

6.  Can one live for God without the Holy Spirit?
 
7.  I want to do the right thing so I’m asking for your help. I no longer work due to health concerns. I do receive Disability benefits. Do I return tithes and offerings from this? I need to know what is right so I can do what is expected of me. I don’t want to rob God. I have been faithful when I was working by returning my tithes and offerings. I don’t want to mess up now.Do we return tithe on disability benefits?
 
8. Will there come a time when people will search for the word of God and will not find it as explained in Amos 8:11-12? Has this ever happened before in history? Can you do a comparison between Amos 8:11-12 and Jeremiah 29:13?  
 
9. If Christian believers go to Heaven, what is the purpose of the New Earth? Who will live on the New Earth and who will live in the New Jerusalem? What is the purpose of the New Earth?

10. What is the meaning of Colossians 2:16?  
 
11. Is Satan the King of Tyre?
 
12. Are the great white throne judgment and the judgment seat of Christ the same event or are they two separate events?
